Instruction: Read the segment of a merger agreement and answer the multiple-choice question by choosing the option that best characterizes the agreement.
Question: How accurate must the fundamental representations and warranties be according to the bring down provision?
Option A: Accurate only if they do not lead to a material adverse effect
Option B: Accurate in all material respects, subject to customary exceptions
Option C: Accurate in all respects, disregarding any materiality qualifications

Merger Agreement: 8.1 Conditions to the Obligations of the Acquiror and Merger Sub. The obligations of the Acquiror and Merger Sub to consummate the Merger are subject to the satisfaction of the following conditions: (a) Representations and Warranties. (i) The representations and warranties of the Company set forth in Article 5 shall be deemed to be true and correct at and as of the Closing Date, as if made on and as of such date, except where the failure of such representations and warranties to be so true and correct (without giving effect to any limitation as to 'materiality' or 'Company Material Adverse Effect') would not reasonably be expected to result in a material adverse effect on the Company, individually or in the aggregate. (ii) All other representations and warranties of the Company that are not subject to any materiality qualifiers shall have been true and correct in all respects as of the date of this Agreement and shall be true and correct as of the Closing Date, as though made on and as of such date (except to the extent that representations and warranties that are made as of a specific date shall only be true and correct as of such date). (Page 77)

Merger Agreement: 6.3 Conditions Precedent to Closing. The obligations of the Acquirer to consummate the transactions contemplated by this Agreement are subject to the satisfaction of the following conditions: (a) the representations and warranties of the Target Company set forth in this Agreement shall be true and correct in all respects as of the date of this Agreement and shall be true and correct at and as of the Closing Date as if made at and as of such time, except to the extent that any such representation or warranty is expressly made as of an earlier date, in which case such representation or warranty shall be true and correct as of such earlier date; (b) the representations and warranties of the Target Company in Sections 3.2, 3.5, and 3.8 shall be accurate in all material respects, except for de minimis inaccuracies that would not reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect; (c) all other representations and warranties contained in this Agreement shall be accurate in all respects, disregarding any qualifiers relating to materiality or Material Adverse Effect (Page 120)
